journey.label: Visitor
journey.customerQuestion: Can I find and load the right page?

journey.label: Understanding
journey.customerQuestion: Do I understand what this business does, where, for whom, and what to do next?

journey.label: Lead
journey.customerQuestion: Can I contact this business without friction or a dead end?

journey.label: Response
journey.customerQuestion: What happens after I reach out, and how fast?

ownerData.title: Speed-to-lead
questions: What is the median time from lead to first human response?
How does that change by lead source (call, form, chat, text, ads)?
Who owns new leads during business hours and after hours?
How many contact attempts are made before a lead is abandoned?
How many inbound calls are missed or abandoned each week?

ownerData.title: After-hours and emergency handling
questions: What happens to a call or form submitted after hours?
Is there an on-call rotation or answering service?
What percentage of after-hours leads become jobs?
Are emergency jobs priced or prioritized differently?

journey.label: Qualification
journey.customerQuestion: Does the lead flow capture enough context to route the job without over-asking?

ownerData.title: Lead quality and routing
questions: Which form fields are actually used to qualify or route a lead?
What percentage of form leads are spam, out of area, or the wrong service?
Where do form leads land, and who sees them?
What information is missing most often when the office calls back?

journey.label: Booking
journey.customerQuestion: Can I book or request an appointment without confusion?

ownerData.title: Booking capacity and confirmation
questions: How many booked jobs are rescheduled or cancelled each week?
Is the online calendar connected to real crew capacity?
Who confirms appointments, and when?
What happens when the requested slot is unavailable?

journey.label: Estimate / Opportunity
journey.customerQuestion: Can I request an estimate and understand what happens next?

ownerData.title: Estimate pipeline
questions: How many estimates are currently open?
What is the total value of open estimates?
What is the average time from request to estimate delivered?
What percentage of estimates are accepted?
What percentage of estimate requests never receive an estimate?

ownerData.title: Estimate close rate by source and size
questions: What is the close rate by lead source?
What is the close rate by job size or service line?
What is the average job value?
Which objections appear most often on estimates?
Which lost reasons are recorded?

journey.label: Follow-up
journey.customerQuestion: Are open estimates and quiet leads followed up until a decision?

ownerData.title: Estimate follow-up
questions: What percentage of open estimates receive follow-up?
How quickly is the first follow-up made?
How many attempts are made before follow-up stops?
Which channels are used (call, text, email)?
Are estimates segmented by size, service, or age?
Are stale estimates reactivated on a schedule?

journey.label: Customer
journey.customerQuestion: What happens after the job is sold and completed?

ownerData.title: Customer history and job completion
questions: How many past customers are in the CRM?
Is job history, equipment age, and service date recorded?
Is there a post-job check-in?
How many customers buy a second service within 12 months?

journey.label: Review
journey.customerQuestion: Does the public experience show credible customer proof?

ownerData.title: Review requests
questions: Are customers automatically asked for a review?
How soon after the job is the ask made?
Is the ask sent by SMS, email, or in person?
Is the process measured by technician or job type?
Is negative feedback captured before it becomes a public review?

journey.label: Referral
journey.customerQuestion: Is there a visible path for a happy customer to refer someone?

ownerData.title: Referral operations
questions: Do you ask for referrals? When and how?
Is there a referral offer or tracking method?
What percentage of new customers come from referrals?
Are referral partners (realtors, property managers, adjacent trades) tracked?
Is referral follow-up owned by someone?

journey.label: Reactivation
journey.customerQuestion: Are past customers and unsold estimates brought back?

ownerData.title: Reactivation and repeat business
questions: How many past customers are inactive for 12+ months?
How many unsold estimates are older than 30, 60, or 90 days?
Are seasonal services or maintenance visits scheduled automatically?
Is there a maintenance plan or membership list?
Has anyone contacted the inactive list in the last year?

checks.name: Service clarity
checks.recommendedIntervention: Name the service in the hero in plain language.

checks.name: Location and service-area clarity
checks.recommendedIntervention: State the city/service area and add local proof.

checks.name: Customer problem and outcome clarity
checks.recommendedIntervention: Name the customer problem and the outcome.

checks.name: Primary action clarity
checks.recommendedIntervention: Use one dominant next step above the fold.

checks.name: Offer specificity and price anchor
checks.recommendedIntervention: Add a starting-at price or range for a core job.

checks.name: Service navigation
checks.recommendedIntervention: Put the top services in the main navigation.

checks.name: Service-area eligibility navigation
checks.recommendedIntervention: Add a service-area list, map, or ZIP check.

checks.name: Language access
checks.recommendedIntervention: Add the configured language path and translate conversion pages.

checks.name: Phone visible and consistent
checks.recommendedIntervention: Use one visible phone number consistently.

checks.name: Click-to-call on mobile
checks.recommendedIntervention: Make the mobile phone a tel: link in a persistent action.

checks.name: Text/SMS path
checks.recommendedIntervention: Add a working sms: link when SMS is enabled.

checks.name: Form exists and is reachable
checks.recommendedIntervention: Make the lead form reachable in two taps.

checks.name: Form friction
checks.recommendedIntervention: Cut fields to name, phone, ZIP, and problem.

checks.name: Form usability
checks.recommendedIntervention: Add labels, input types, autocomplete, and a reachable submit.

checks.name: Online scheduler or booking
checks.recommendedIntervention: Add a working scheduler with live availability.

checks.name: No conversion dead end
checks.recommendedIntervention: End every high-intent page with a next step.

checks.name: Chat or callback request
checks.recommendedIntervention: Add a human-backed chat or callback when enabled.

checks.name: Response and acknowledgement promise
checks.recommendedIntervention: Publish a response time, channel, and hours.

checks.name: After-hours or emergency path
checks.recommendedIntervention: State hours and the after-hours or emergency path.

checks.name: Booking path steps and mobile usability
checks.recommendedIntervention: Reduce booking steps and keep the path on-site.

checks.name: Confirmation expectations
checks.recommendedIntervention: State what happens after submission and when.

checks.name: Qualification context without over-asking
checks.recommendedIntervention: Capture service, ZIP or area, problem, and contact preference.

checks.name: Estimate or quote request workflow
checks.recommendedIntervention: Add an estimate request with scope and a clear next step.

checks.name: Review volume, source, and profile link
checks.recommendedIntervention: Show rating, count, source, and a profile link.

checks.name: Specific testimonials and case studies
checks.recommendedIntervention: Add named stories with job type and outcome.

checks.name: Real project proof
checks.recommendedIntervention: Caption real job photos with city, job, and result.

checks.name: License, insurance, and certifications
checks.recommendedIntervention: Show license, insurance, and relevant certifications.

checks.name: Guarantee and warranty specificity
checks.recommendedIntervention: State the warranty term and scope.

checks.name: Identity and differentiation consistency
checks.recommendedIntervention: Use one identity and one verifiable differentiator.

checks.name: Mobile LCP
checks.recommendedIntervention: Compress the hero and defer non-critical scripts.

checks.name: Mobile layout usability
checks.recommendedIntervention: Fix viewport, text size, clipping, and menu usability.

checks.name: Tap targets and persistent action
checks.recommendedIntervention: Use 44px targets and a persistent action.

checks.name: HTTPS and security
checks.recommendedIntervention: Serve HTTPS with a valid certificate.

checks.name: Broken links, CTAs, and conversion-blocking errors
checks.recommendedIntervention: Fix broken links, CTAs, forms, and conversion-blocking errors.

checks.name: Title, meta description, and H1
checks.recommendedIntervention: Put service and city in title, meta, and H1.

checks.name: Indexability
checks.recommendedIntervention: Fix canonical, robots, and sitemap.

checks.name: Local schema and NAP consistency
checks.recommendedIntervention: Add LocalBusiness or Service schema and consistent NAP.

checks.name: Service and location pages with unique content
checks.recommendedIntervention: Build unique service and location pages.

checks.name: Analytics present
checks.recommendedIntervention: Install GA4, GTM, or an equivalent analytics platform.

checks.name: Conversion and paid-traffic measurement
checks.recommendedIntervention: Add conversion events and ads or call tracking.

optionalModules.label: Multilingual access
optionalModules.description: Enable when the target market needs a language other than the primary site language. Configure preferredLanguages, for example ["en", "es"].

optionalModules.label: Text/SMS path
optionalModules.description: Enable when the business accepts texted leads or the market expects SMS.

optionalModules.label: Chat or callback request
optionalModules.description: Enable when a human-backed chat or callback channel is part of the intended lead mix.

optionalModules.label: After-hours or emergency path
optionalModules.description: Enable for emergency, restoration, HVAC, plumbing, pest, and similar trades. Disable for businesses that do not take urgent work.

optionalModules.label: License, insurance, and certifications
optionalModules.description: Enable where licensing or insurance is a meaningful buyer concern. It is scored only on visible claims.

optionalModules.label: Financing and payment path
optionalModules.description: High-ticket trades may benefit. It is an opportunity flag and owner-data question, not a universal score penalty.

optionalModules.label: Video or VSL
optionalModules.description: A video can help some offers, but its absence is not a revenue leak for every trade. Report it as an opportunity only.

optionalModules.label: Maintenance plan or membership
optionalModules.description: A continuity offer is valuable when the trade has recurring service needs. It is not a universal score requirement.

optionalModules.label: Tiered packages or premium option
optionalModules.description: Useful for some offers, irrelevant for others. Report as an opportunity, not a penalty.

optionalModules.label: Paid priority or same-day option
optionalModules.description: An optional revenue architecture choice. Report when it fits the trade and market.

optionalModules.label: Detailed price transparency
optionalModules.description: A price anchor is scored lightly in Understand. A full price list is optional and should be investigated, not assumed.

optionalModules.label: Content freshness
optionalModules.description: Fresh advice content can help search and trust, but it is not a universal revenue-leak penalty.

optionalModules.label: Named lead magnet
optionalModules.description: A named low-friction offer can help. Report as an opportunity when the current offer is only a generic free estimate.

optionalModules.label: Referral program
optionalModules.description: Public referral signals are sparse. Treat referral operations as an owner-data opportunity.

optionalModules.label: Paid traffic landing experience
optionalModules.description: Enable when ads are known to point at the site. Inspect landing-page relevance, CTA, phone/form, speed, mobile usability, and measurement. Never invent ad spend or performance.

serviceMappings.label: Revenue Recovery
serviceMappings.description: Recover revenue from open estimates, unsold opportunities, and conversion leaks.

serviceMappings.label: Speed-to-Lead
serviceMappings.description: Improve response time, routing, booking, and lead handling.

serviceMappings.label: Customer Reactivation
serviceMappings.description: Bring back inactive customers and past opportunities.

serviceMappings.label: Market Intelligence
serviceMappings.description: Improve local visibility, service-area clarity, and market positioning.

serviceMappings.label: Marketing Intelligence
serviceMappings.description: Connect lead sources, measurement, and channel profitability.

serviceMappings.label: Cost Compression
serviceMappings.description: Reduce waste from slow, broken, or unusable digital experiences.
